items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: Oh, I played with Happy Schilling around, right after I left Brownlee.

ctx.x: When did you play with Happy Schilling?
Oh, I played with Happy Schilling around, right after I left Brownlee. What date could that have been? Around 1926? Something like that.
Well, you know, we never did find out when you took up trumpet and carneted you.
